description: Source code implementing Bluetooth channel selection algorithms and related functions for the Zephyr project, including algorithms for channel remapping, pseudo-random number generation, and ISO-specific channel handling.

methods.name: chan_sel_remap
methods.description: Remaps a channel index based on the channel map, used in channel selection algorithm #2.

methods.name: chan_rev_8
methods.description: Reverses bits in a byte, used for bit manipulation in channel permutation.

methods.name: chan_perm
methods.description: Permutes bits of a 16-bit value for pseudo-random number generation.

methods.name: chan_mam
methods.description: Mixing function used in PRN calculation.

methods.name: chan_prn_s
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random number based on counter and channel ID.

methods.name: chan_prn_e
methods.description: Generates an extended pseudo-random number for channel selection.

methods.name: chan_prn_subevent_se
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random number for ISO subevent channel selection.

methods.name: chan_d
methods.description: Calculates the parameter 'd' for ISO subevent channel mapping.

methods.name: lll_chan_sel_2
methods.description: Implements Bluetooth channel selection algorithm #2 for ACL connections.

methods.name: lll_chan_iso_event
methods.description: Handles ISO first subevent channel selection.

methods.name: lll_chan_iso_subevent
methods.description: Handles ISO subsequent subevent channel selection.
